title: That There Is No Idol in the World
author: Gregory Thaumaturgus
edition: PG 10; Eis to ouden eidolon en kosmo (Khazarzar)
blurb: Gregory Thaumaturgus, short Greek scrap on true honor versus honor of what is not God.
era_note: These Greek scraps belong to the first three centuries of the church (or the early fourth, disclosed in the work note when later).

text_history.method: Original English Translation of Gregory Thaumaturgus, Eis to ouden eidolon en kosmo — new OET from PG 10 Greek.
